question: Can the fixed operator-owned HTTPS seed renew approved metadata without fabricating independent-network proof?
decision: Require not-required-operator-seed and explicit null outside-proof digest only for the normalized exact https://minimodel.org/ origin. Preserve current-passed plus SHA-256 for every other admitted peer.
authority: Owner-authorized MiniModel initial seeding and maintainable existing-host renewal; root reviewed this concrete contract defect before implementation.
preserved_contracts: Strict direct-peer URL admission, TLS and same-origin member paths
Detached Ed25519 signing payload including origin, proof disposition and digest
Key validity, metadata monotonicity and maximum 24-hour freshness

implementation.wire_fields: No new fields or signing format; strict existing proof fields now have two origin-bound dispositions.
implementation.compatibility: No qualified public initial seed exists to preserve under the superseded operator/current-passed combination. Third-party proof requirements remain intact.

validation.new_cases: Valid signed operator/null projection and six-member synthetic installation; public IP/loopback cannot use exemption; spoofed domain, userinfo, trailing dot, HTTP downgrade, alternate port/path/query reject; missing/wrong-type/non-null proof rejects; changing signed origin/disposition/digest without resigning fails; normalized uppercase/default-443 equivalence remains valid; third-party SHA proof remains required; preflight never equates an announcement to reachability.
validation.coverage_scope: Whole-file measured percentages, not inflated changed-code percentages. Both new proof branches and rejection paths are covered.
retained_earlier_results: tool-output:fc2219: Tiny 138/139; generated shell identities were not yet refreshed. Same sources passed after existing deterministic generator refreshed hashes.

tool-output:9c4b21: Mini 49/51; an older origin-only fixture still used third-party proof for MiniModel, and the index script cache hash was stale. Fixture now uses the current origin-bound disposition; existing script identity was refreshed.
validation.independent_read_only_review: runtime_state_review found no material defect in normalized origin selection, strict null/SHA branches, signed payload binding, installer/preflight sharing or Mini mirror. Review does not prove hosted renewal or seed reachability.

presentation: Only existing script cache identities changed in Tiny app/root HTML and Mini index.html; Tiny offline-worker generated identities updated. No visible copy/style/component changes. No screenshot comparison is claimed.
publication_status: Local implementation only. No public seed, model qualification, renewal service or new outside-network observation is established.
remaining: Exact receipt/admission binding and seed streaming publication; nonsecret exact-host PHP/HTTP-denial capability proof; reviewed hosted request renewal; actual qualified model and live browser acceptance.
reusable_lesson: A trusted operator HTTPS seed needs an explicit signed responsibility statement. Requiring recurring independent-peer evidence for that fixed origin creates an availability dependency without adding the intended third-party routing assurance.
